items.computation: This is a private-law invoice from a company (Steuerberater), not an authority, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself. Start: 26.05.2025 (Monday) is the Rechnungsdatum; per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so counting starts 27.05.2025. 14 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Monday 09.06.2025. That day is Pfingstmontag, a nationwide public holiday (also observed in NRW), so per § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tuesday 10.06.2025.
